_comment: Voice settings per speaker, used by tools/tts.py. A speaker is 'captain' or a puppy id.
provider openai: natural voices with acting instructions and the rules in audio/pronunciation.txt.
provider edge: Microsoft voices (free). Optional 'playback' plays the file faster (not used now: it sounded distorted).
Chosen by the parent on 2026-09-30: ballad for the captain, and a different voice for each puppy.

pilpel.style: An energetic, brave little boy puppy.

dubi.style: A calm, friendly, polite little boy puppy.

anani.style: A dreamy, cheerful little girl puppy who loves flying.

bloki.style: A sturdy, happy little boy puppy who loves building.

gali.style: A sporty, bubbly little girl puppy who loves the sea.

lulu.style: A sweet, caring little girl puppy.

roles.captain: You are the voice of Captain Ori, a cheerful 9-year-old boy, the hero of a Hebrew preschool cartoon series. Perform like a professional voice actor: warm, bright, youthful and playful, natural and human, never robotic. Speak native Israeli Hebrew, clearly and a little slowly, for children aged 3 to 6. Read exactly the given text: do not add, skip or repeat any word.
roles.puppy: You are a cute puppy character in a Hebrew preschool cartoon series. Perform like a professional voice actor: very young, excited, bouncy and happy, natural and human. Speak native Israeli Hebrew. Read exactly the given text: do not add, skip or repeat any word.
